name: Greed-extreme fade ONLY on volatility-blowoff exhaustion (asymmetric short)
rationale: MECHANISM: the family thesis says do NOT symmetrically short greed — the herd runs you over in the reinforcing phase. This spec fades greed ONLY in the narrow regime where it historically resolves down: a volatility BLOWOFF top. When fear_greed is at an extreme high AND realized vol has SPIKED above a fitted ceiling (parabolic exhaustion, not orderly herding) AND price is over-extended above its band (bb_z above a fitted high), the marginal buyer is the last FOMO holder and the move is unsustainable. This is the disciplined, asymmetric complement to the continuation specs — it fades greed in the ONE regime where continuation fails. Short; exit when vol subsides or bb_z normalizes, or stop/TP/time. DISCONFIRMER: compare fade-greed here vs ride-greed on the SAME blowoff bars — if riding is not worse in the blowoff subset, the exhaustion regime is illusory and shorting greed is just the losing symmetric trade; kill. Also kill if net-of-fee short return does not beat sitting flat (borrow/funding costs eat it).
catalyst: extreme greed at a volatility blowoff with price over-extended
